general.description: Manage and evaluate storefront A/B tests

detail.name: Name
detail.decisionMetricHelp: This metric drives the verdict. The other metrics are shown as context.
detail.tabInPreparation: This view will be added in an upcoming update.
detail.statsEmpty: No evaluation loaded yet. Click “Refresh evaluation”.
detail.verdictWinner: Variant {variant} wins: {lift} {metric} — safe to roll out.
detail.verdictWorse: Variant {variant} is significantly worse on {metric} — do not roll out.
detail.verdictNotEnoughData: Not enough data yet for a reliable decision.
detail.verdictNoDifference: No significant difference between the variants.
detail.segmentsEmpty: No splittable segments (yet) for this experiment.

help.assignments: Number of visitors assigned to this variant (sample size).
help.rate: Share of assigned visitors who converted (e.g. purchased).
help.revenuePerVisitor: Revenue divided by assigned visitors — captures both conversion and order value.
help.lift: Relative change versus the control. +10% means the variant is 10% above the control.
help.pValue: Probability that the difference is pure chance. Small (below 0.05) = the result is likely real.
help.confidenceInterval: Range in which the variant's true value lies with 95% certainty.
help.significance: Whether the difference is statistically reliable (not chance) — and in which direction.
help.requiredSample: Assignments per variant needed to statistically confirm the observed difference.

detail.srmWarning: Warning: the observed split differs significantly from the configured weights (possible tracking/bucketing issue).
detail.recBetter: Variant {variant} is significantly better — safe to roll out.
detail.recWorse: Variant {variant} is significantly worse — do not roll out.
detail.recNoDifference: Variant {variant}: no measurable difference from the control.
detail.recNotEnoughData: Variant {variant}: not enough data yet ({current} of {required} assignments per variant needed).
detail.salesChannelHelp: Empty = applies to all sales channels.
detail.variantConfigHelp: Optional JSON object, e.g. for theme/feature-flag variants.
detail.variantConfigInvalid: The variant config contains invalid JSON.
detail.variantCmsPageHelp: The CMS page (Shopping Experience) delivered for this variant. Control = the page currently served live.

errors.onlyRunningCanBePaused: Only running experiments can be paused.
errors.winnerNotInExperiment: The selected winner variant does not belong to this experiment.
errors.onlyDoneCanBeArchived: Only finished experiments can be archived.
errors.tooFewVariants: An experiment needs at least two variants.
errors.negativeWeight: Variant weights must not be negative.
errors.weightSum: The variant weights must add up to 100.
errors.controlCount: An experiment needs exactly one control variant.
errors.cmsPageMissing: In a CMS page test every variant needs a selected CMS page.
